# pantoken

> Instructure UI design tokens and icons, exported once and re-shaped for many platforms — CSS, JS,
> native (Swift/Android/Compose/Flutter), design tools (Figma), and framework integrations. Tokens
> are CSS custom properties named `--instui-*`; icons come from Lucide + Instructure custom glyphs.
>
> Built and used internally at Instructure, then open-sourced without official Instructure
> warranty/support — published under [github.com/thedannywahl/pantoken](https://github.com/thedannywahl/pantoken)
> rather than the `instructure` org for now, not a third party.

## Getting started

- [Unified package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pantoken/pantoken): `npm i @pantoken/pantoken` — every target under one import; subpaths like `@pantoken/pantoken/css`, `@pantoken/pantoken/react`, `@pantoken/pantoken/tailwind`.
- Ready-made styled components (plain HTML/CSS): `@pantoken/components` — `components.css`, `base.css`,
	`utilities.css`, `prose.css`. Pair with `@pantoken/plugin-layouts` (app-shell layout) and
	`@pantoken/plugin-custom-components` (additional components like `banner` and `agent-shell`). Card is included in `@pantoken/components`.
- Web CSS from raw tokens (no components): `@pantoken/css` — `import "@pantoken/css/inject"` defines all `--instui-*` properties.
- Tokens as data: `@pantoken/tokens` — `import { tokens, byTheme } from "@pantoken/tokens"`.
- Icons: `@pantoken/icons` for raw decoded SVG markup/data (`getIcon("arrow-left")`), or
	`@pantoken/web-components` for a drop-in `<instui-icon>` custom element.
- Component behaviors (vanilla JS): `@pantoken/interactions` — `initModal`, `initTooltip`,
	`initInPlaceEdit`, `initCloseButton`; IIFE entry points for CDN. `initInPlaceEdit` accepts an
	optional `text`, `number`, `email`, `url`, `tel`, or `search` input hint, but the consuming
	application validates committed values.
- Tree browser: ARIA tree markup needs `initTreeBrowser` or `tree-browser.iife.js` for keyboard
	navigation. Name the tree, use focusable treeitems, and associate collection rows with groups via
	`aria-owns`. CSS-only details/summary disclosures don't claim tree roles.
- Drawer layout: give `<instui-drawer-layout>` nonempty `tray-label` and `content-label`
	attributes to name its shadow-DOM regions. Labels on slotted content don't name those panes.
- Form validation: opt into `initFormField(host, control, error)` or `data-native-validation` plus
	`form-field.iife.js`, with a separate error and unique ID. CSS alone doesn't synchronize error
	associations; client-side checks don't replace server validation.
- Menus: opt into `initMenu(menu, button)` or `data-menu-navigation` plus `menu.iife.js` for
	vertical, single-level native popover menus. Applications own actions and checked state;
	disabled items need `aria-disabled`. Submenus and menubars aren't supported.
- shadcn registry: `shadcn search @pantoken`, `shadcn view @pantoken/<item>`, then `shadcn add
	@pantoken/<item>`. Items install CSS/packages and usage metadata, not React components.
- Standalone browser mockups: use the CDN guide, component capability manifest, demos, and optional
	per-component interaction IIFEs. Sendable email uses `@pantoken/email` `inlineEmailHtml` or
	`pantoken generate email`; generic HTML/CSS inlining uses `@pantoken/inline-styles` or
	`pantoken generate inline`.

## Frameworks

- React: `@pantoken/react` · Vue: `@pantoken/vue` · Svelte: `@pantoken/svelte` · Angular: `@pantoken/angular` · React Native: `@pantoken/react-native`
- Markdown: `@pantoken/react-markdown`, `@pantoken/rehype`

## Build tools

- `@pantoken/vite` · `@pantoken/next` · `@pantoken/webpack` · `@pantoken/tailwind` · `@pantoken/postcss`

## Theming other systems

- `@pantoken/shadcn` · `@pantoken/bootstrap` · `@pantoken/storybook`

## Native & other ecosystems (CLI: `pantoken generate <target>`)

- swift, android, compose, flutter, rust, wordpress, vanilla, drupal, jekyll, hugo — add
	`--icons`, `--theme`, `--out`, and for rust `--format`.
- Check https://pantoken.app/target-compatibility.json before claiming a supported host version;
	its `$schema` field identifies the published schema. Verified releases and environments are
	bounded evidence, not promises about newer versions.

## AI tooling for consumers

- `@pantoken/ai` provides installable agent assets: `AGENTS.md`, `llms.txt`, and editor/assistant
	rules for Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, and Claude Code.
- CLI: `npx pantoken-ai init [--tool <all|agents|llms|cursor|copilot|windsurf|claude>] [--dir <path>]`.

## Design & interchange

- `@pantoken/dtcg` (W3C DTCG JSON) · `@pantoken/scss` · `@pantoken/figma` (Figma Variables) · `@pantoken/email`

## Conventions

- Token names: `--instui-<group>-<name>` (e.g. `--instui-color-background-brand`).
- Themes: rebrand (default), canvas, canvasHighContrast. Prefer `var(--instui-*)` references for theming.
